name: ymer
description: Brainstorm, scout, define, plan, harden, implement, review: a seven-phase practice that takes a change in Claude Code from a rough idea to a shipped commit. What you get is work that holds up. Every phase leaves a written record that the next session builds on, plans and code both face an adversarial review before they land, and anything you notice along the way goes into a pool, so your next piece of work is drawn from it instead of recalled from memory. Runs on a Ymer Node you host locally; a ymer.ax account is optional.

state_folder.title: State folder
state_folder.description: Required. The one folder your topics live in — any folder, under version control or not: /ymer:setup verifies it, drawn topics get folders beneath it, and its history is git where it is a git work tree and your Ymer Node's notebook otherwise.

front.title: Front
front.description: Required. A name for this installation, in lowercase snake_case — letters, digits and _, starting with a letter. Every drop you capture is filed under it and a mint draws only its own, so give each installation its own name and keep it: /ymer:setup registers it, and lists the names your Ymer Node already holds.
